title: Microwave Cinnamon Roll Mug Cake
hookLine: Warm fluffy bakery cinnamon roll in a coffee mug in literally 90 seconds of microwave time.

items.name: Self-rising flour (or flour + 1/4 tsp baking powder)

steps.title: Grease Mug & Measure Base
steps.instructionTemplate: Lightly coat a wide, microwave-safe mug or ramekin with a thin swipe of oil or butter so the cake releases cleanly. Measure {self_flour} and {milk_m} right into the mug and whisk with a fork until completely smooth.

steps.title: Mix Batter Right in Your Mug
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {self_flour}, {milk_m}, and 1 tbsp melted butter in a microwave-safe mug until lump-free. Keep {self_flour} and {milk_m} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Stop microwaving while the center of Microwave Cinnamon Roll Mug Cake still looks slightly glossy—residual heat finishes cooking it in 45 seconds so it stays fudgy, never rubbery.

steps.title: Swirl Cinnamon & Microwave 75 Seconds
steps.instructionTemplate: Swirl {cinn_sugar} into the center with a toothpick. Microwave 75 seconds until pillowy, then drizzle cream cheese icing while steaming.
steps.criticalTip: Do not overcook! 75 seconds keeps the center velvety and cake-soft.

steps.title: Rest 1 Minute & Add Toppings
steps.instructionTemplate: Let the mug rest 60 seconds after microwaving so the steam settles and the center finishes setting into a tender, spoonable crumb. Top with {cinn_sugar} and enjoy warm right from the mug.

ugcQuotes.quote: Late night study savior. Took 2 mins and tasted like Cinnabon.
